sources.snippet: Geiping et al. (2025) pretrain a depth-recurrent transformer from scratch on 800 billion tokens at substantial cost. Although their model can reuse parameters at test time to scale up compute and improve performance, their work also uses a large number of recurrent iterations during training, which significantly slows down training compared to a fixed depth model with the same parameter count ...

sources.snippet: Pretraining large-scale models requires high performance, flexibility, and scalability. Lightning AI offers tools and strategies to accelerate model pretraining on multi-GPU and multi-node systems, with deep support for PyTorch Lightning and Lightning Fabric.
